_comment: Named figure sets: one entry = one comparison = one directory results/<experiment>/sweep/<NAME>/
with fixed file names, so results stay stable across re-runs instead of accumulating ad-hoc PNGs.
(scripts/06_plot_comparison.py --set NAME). `arms` is also the legend order. `baseline` is the
arm the ratio and paired figures divide by: the production engine on that set's card, or the
reference configuration of the comparison. Register a set here rather than passing --arms by
hand; a set is the reproducible unit, and its manifest.json records what it was read from.
Every arm in a set needs an entry in configs/arm_style.json with a hue no other arm in the set uses.

of3kit_rtxpro6000.title: Anthropic openfold3_ob0 kit vs stock OpenFold3, openbind weights, RTX PRO 6000
_note: of3kit_fast_templateoff and of3kit_big_templateoff are deliberately NOT in this set.
of3kit_big_templateoff ran with the kit's reach gate at its H100 table value (4500 tokens),
which at 4500 swapped the fused pair kernels for the row-block trunk streamed through host
memory and was then killed by the host OOM killer under a 64 GB request: its boundary is an
artefact of that configuration, not of the mode. of3kit_big_reachoff_templateoff is the same
mode measured with the gate held open and is what this set shows.
of3kit_fast_templateoff was dropped with it, pending a re-run; note that the reach gate does
not exist in `fast` (modes.REACH_LINES is (('big', 'resident'),) only), so its GPU OOM at
4500 tokens is a real memory boundary and a re-run is expected to reproduce it.
of3kit_exact_templateoff is out for a different reason: it measures the stock arithmetic,
which of3kit_off already carries here.

af3kit_a100.title: Anthropic af3_jax kit modes vs stock, preview-2 weights, A100 80GB

production_options.title: What we could run instead of today's engine: both codebases, both cards
_note: The decision set. af3_openbind_templateoff is the engine in production today, and the
baseline every speed-up is quoted against. The other three are the alternatives:
the OpenFold3 kit's `big` on the same RTX PRO 6000, and the A100 pair (stock AlphaFold 3
against the af3_jax kit's `big`) which say whether the kit is worth it on the older card.
Weights are NOT held fixed here: the A100 kit arms run the preview-2 weights, the others
openbind, so the legend spells the weights out and a time difference between an openbind
arm and a p2 arm is not only the launcher. Read it as what each option costs to run, not
as a controlled comparison of launchers -- of3kit_rtxpro6000 and af3kit_a100 are those.
The two af3kit_*_a100 arms have not been swept yet; until they are, this set draws the
two arms that have data and records the rest under missing_arms in its manifest.
